title: Get a job
description: Returns HTTP 200 with id, status, createdAt, expiresAt, and optional error or downloadUrl. Jobs are scoped to your key. Missing, deleted, expired, or differently owned jobs return 404.

sections.title: Behavior
paragraphs: Returns HTTP 200 with id, status, createdAt, expiresAt, and optional error or downloadUrl. Jobs are scoped to your key. Missing, deleted, expired, or differently owned jobs return 404.

sections.title: Response fields
paragraphs: Successful reads return HTTP 200, including when the conversion itself failed. Inspect status before deciding to download.
table: Current ISO expiry timestamp, refreshed on completion.
Failure message, present on failed jobs.
Relative authenticated download route after success.

sections.title: Polling behavior
paragraphs: Use one poll at a time with a bounded wait interval and overall deadline. Small jobs may reach succeeded before your first read. A 404 means the job is not available to this key, so polling should stop.
Status reads do not extend retention and do not trigger a retry of a failed conversion. Resubmission is a separate POST with a new job ID.
